evidence: mypy over gateway/ mcp/ workers/ reported 'Success: no issues found in 279 source files' in a venv holding only requirements.txt, and seven errors across mcp/imagen/retry.py, engines/imagen4.py, and server.py in the same tree once google-genai and google-api-core were installed. google-genai and google-api-core appear only in mcp/imagen/requirements.txt, which .github/workflows/tests.yml never installs.
impact: Seven real type errors sat on main unseen. They surfaced only through #453's pre-push hook, which runs where the image stack is installed, and there they blocked every push regardless of what the change touched, including a docs-only commit.
promotion_reason: single non-critical observation; collect another occurrence
suggested_change: Install mcp/imagen/requirements.txt in the typecheck job so CI checks the same surface the pre-push hook does.
summary: The Tests workflow's typecheck job installs only requirements.txt, so mcp/imagen's declared dependencies resolve to Any and an entire class of type error is invisible to CI while blocking every local push.
verified_by: mypy gateway/ mcp/ workers/ scripts/runpod_worker_smoke_test.py run in two venvs, with and without google-genai/google-api-core installed
